message: Replacing the game's minecraft:block.stone.place takes files to play instead: "files": ["block/break_1.ogg"]
"minecraft:Stone Break" isn't one of the game's sound events: they're written like "minecraft:block.stone.break"
"acme:block.stone.break" isn't a usable sound key (path segments of lowercase letters, digits and _, joined by /); the game's own sound events are replaced by their name in the minecraft namespace
Another resource pack replaces minecraft:block.stone.break too; only one can
